dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A primary large, irregular annular structure is centered on the mid-dorsal flank, characterized by a jagged perimeter and a sharp gradient transition from dark exterior pixels to light interior pixels. Two smaller, less complete 'C' shaped arcs are visible posterior to the primary ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated high-intensity pixel cluster located on the upper dorsal ridge. Scattered lower-density, high-intensity point-source pixels are visible across the anterior-lateral neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship defined by the centroids of the primary dorsal-lateral annulus, the superior dorsal ridge blob, and the immediate posterior-lateral annulus, forming an obtuse triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reticulated pattern of light-colored lines forming a mesh-like topology between larger annular features on the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
